image_description: A large African crocodile (Nile crocodile) lying on a sandy bank with green grass in the background. The crocodile is positioned diagonally across the frame, with its head toward the upper left and tail extending toward the lower right. The body is elongated and covered in dark, textured scutes. The tail is long and muscular, showing the characteristic ridges along its length. The crocodile appears to be basking in the sun.
image_class: African crocodile, Nile crocodile, Crocodylus niloticus
